name: Healthchecks
description: Healthchecks is a watchdog for your cron jobs. It's a web server that listens for pings from your cron jobs, plus a web interface.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Superuser password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-healthchecks application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-healthchecks
  # The `big-bear-healthchecks` service definition
  big-bear-healthchecks:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-healthchecks
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: linuxserver/healthchecks:5.0.20261020@sha256:941ef825ead30253fd0571e94d66a98a85e65f46d99cd07f117033e28863e9e2
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - SITE_ROOT=http://[YOUR_CASAOS_IP]
      - SITE_NAME="Big Bear HealthChecks"
      - SUPERUSER_EMAIL=user@example.com
      - SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=${SECRET_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD}
      - ALLOWED_HOSTS= #optional
      - APPRISE_ENABLED=False #optional
      - CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS= #optional
      - DEBUG=True #optional
      - DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL= #optional
      - EMAIL_HOST= #optional
      - EMAIL_PORT= #optional
      - EMAIL_HOST_USER= #optional
      - EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD= #optional
      - EMAIL_USE_TLS= #optional
      - INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS= #optional
      - PING_EMAIL_DOMAIN= #optional
      - RP_ID= #optional
      - SECRET_KEY="${SECRET_SECRET_KEY}" #optional
      - SITE_LOGO_URL= #optional
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8000 of the host to port 8000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
      # Mapping port 2525 of the host to port 2525 of the container
      - "2525:2525"
